newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia Jan-May load factor rises to 72.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Iberia Jan-May load factor rises to 72.2 pct.

text.p: Spanish flag carrier Iberia said on Thursday its passenger load factor climbed to 72.2 percent in the first five months of the year, a rise of 4.5 points on the same period a year earlier.
The airline flew 6.14 million passengers, an increase of 10 percent on the previous year.
"If this trend continues, at the end of the year Iberia will have transported 1.5 million passengers more than the previous year, with a figure of around 16 million," the airline said in a statement.
Iberia said that in the past six months it had gained 2.3 points in market share for business travellers between Spain and Europe.
The airline transported 43 percent of passengers travelling in Business Class between Spain and Europe.
Iberia also gained on traffic between Spain and Latin America, for which it is market leader. The airline transported 15 percent passengers between the two continents.
Nationwide, Iberia said it had also increased the number of passengers transported and began to recuperate market share recently lost to competition.
